title: Russian Invaders Use AI To Make Deepfake Videos Of Triumphs In Ukraine
summary: Russia’s invading troops have ramped up the use of OpenAI and Bytedance text-to-video AI software to depict fabricated victories in taking over Ukrainian territory.
